verdict.rationale: Published usage pricing is a fair question for a media relay/CDN product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no pricing information at all: no per-participant-minute rate, no per-bandwidth rate, and no plan tiers. It covers only self-hosting, a public test relay, and third-party CDN options, none of which documents pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales
